title: Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy
hook_text: Anthropic is hitting a compute wall
script:
Anthropic is struggling to secure enough server capacity for its AI models.
Cloud providers now increasingly view the company as a direct market competitor.
CEO Dario Amodei must navigate these tensions while relying on those same providers.
The company relies on these third-party cloud platforms to train its Claude models.
Public cloud giants are prioritizing their own internal AI projects over external clients.
These providers are hesitant to grant Anthropic the massive compute scale it requires.
Will this cloud squeeze force a delay in their growth plans?
